Hi everyone  
  
I’m Orhan, one of the builders of Orbit.  
  
The part I’m most proud of is something you barely notice: the moment you tap a locked app. Instead of a dead end, Orbit asks “What for?“. Need to reply to someone? You get 2 minutes, and only for that one app. Just want to scroll? That’s when you have to earn it.  
  
A few design choices we made along the way:

The Gate (our mini game) only allows 3 shifts a day, so the game can’t become the new feed

Pay to unlock caps at $9.99 and resets every Monday, so it motivates instead of punishing [...] Last month, my Screen Time report said 10h 19m a day. More than 80% of it was doomscrolling. I was a full-on blue light zombie: in bed at 1 AM, saying “just one more video,” waking up tired. Finally I asked myself, what am I doing with my life??

I tried every digital detox trick. Deleting apps only to reinstall them in the next hour 😅. Grayscale mode. A “dopamine detox” weekend. Strict blockers I learned to bypass in two taps.

That last one showed us the real problem: getting back in was free. One tap and I was scrolling again. So we built Orbit around one idea: every unlock should cost you something.
